strings.en: Wh-What...!? What is this place...!?
The scenery suddenly changed!? And these red, stone-like things...
...A Stone Circle...!
You're right.
It looks like... the one that surrounded the Saotome Laboratory...!?
...Yeah. If that thing had kept growing, it'd look like this.
They remade it...!? Turned the Muge universe... into their own!?
Good grief...! We defeated Muge Zorbados, but...
we need to find some way out of this space...
...N-No... Captain...!
Excellen!? What's wrong...!?
Excellen...!?
...We have to... go now... Captain...!
Or it'll be too late...!
What do you mean? What's in this universe!?
It looks like Excellen is sensing something.
Is there still more, even at this point...!? Hey, pull yourself together!
The universe... will spread... And then...
What are you talking about!? Hey, lady!
They're... making their move, aren't they!? Excellen!
...Let us go, Captain Bright.
Princess Romina, but...
The Elshank is fine. Shaff, what about everyone's units?
The maintenance crew reports our remaining supplies will be plenty.
The work will be finished shortly.
How about the Nadesico?
This is the Nadesico. Mr. Uribatake?
Uribatake here, on deck.
Figured this might happen, so I saved enough gear for one more fight!
But this is the last of it, got it?
Erina,
how many of the stones the Nadesico uses to move through space remain?
You mean CCs. ...We're out.
If at all possible, we should travel normally...
...Erina, how many remain?
F-Fine, I get it! Enough for one more jump! Ahh, my precious CCs...
Scary. ...She's really fired up.
What's gotten into Princess Romina?
...I think it's the right choice, Princess Romina. I have a really bad feeling...
You think so?
Geez! Koji, you're so dense!
If we miss this chance... it might be too late!
Captain Bright... what will you do?
It doesn't look like we have time to deliberate, Captain.
...All right. Londo Bell will now
enter the other dimension, likely created by the Einst.
...There's no telling what will happen. Stay sharp.
...I pray this will be the last battle to protect the galaxy.
...Alchemie...
